reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body: I'm surprised there are no tests without the feature enabled...

reviewCommentsList.author: pratikmankawde
reviewCommentsList.body: Major: Shouldn't we be using the `fix` prefix in `CheckThreading`, when passed to `XRPL_RETIRE` macro?

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body:
Good point, I was wondering about that too actually.

@a1q123456 if this is indeed needed, shouldn't the `XRPL_RETIRE` macro have failed if the amendment name doesn't exist?

reviewCommentsList.author: a1q123456
reviewCommentsList.body:
Ah sorry, yeah, we should.

Regarding @bthomee's question, no, `XRPL_RETIRE` only defines a global variable marked with obsolete and it doesn't do anything more. So, as long as no code references to it, it won't complain.
